pdp.page_title: Custom Kiss Cut Stickers | Easy Peel, Full Color
pdp.meta_description: Custom Kiss Cut Stickers - easy-peel, fade & water-resistant with full-color printing. Perfect for packaging, giveaways & creative branding.
pdp.description_html:
Kiss cut stickers are cut through the sticker layer only, leaving the backing paper intact, so each sticker sits inside a border that makes it easy to peel and apply. The cut follows the exact shape of your design, regular or irregular, for a clean, professional finish.

Why choose kiss cut?

  • Easy peel: the surrounding backing gives you something to hold, so even small or intricate designs lift off cleanly.
  • Printable background: add your branding, contact details, or a promotional message on the paper around the sticker itself.
  • Full color digital printing: vibrant detail and precise color in every design.
  • Fade and water resistant: built for long lasting use.
  • Protects intricate shapes: the border shields fine cut lines during handling and handouts.
  • No Minimum: order the quantity your project needs.

Kiss cut stickers are ideal for giveaways, packaging inserts, event handouts, and product branding. If you want a standalone sticker cut to the exact edge of your artwork with no border, choose our die cut sticker instead.

What is a kiss cut sticker?
A sticker cut through the top layer only, leaving the backing intact. Each sticker sits inside a border of backing paper that makes peeling easy.

What is the difference between kiss cut and die cut?
Kiss cut stickers keep their backing border and peel off the paper. Die cut stickers are cut through the backing too, so each one is a standalone sticker shaped exactly like your design.

Can I print on the background around the sticker?
Yes. The surrounding paper can carry your branding, a message, or contact details for extra impact when you hand them out.

Is there a minimum order?
No Minimum. Order one kiss cut sticker or hundreds, whatever the project calls for.

How durable are kiss cut stickers?
They are printed in full color and are fade and water resistant, built to hold up through handling and everyday use.

What are kiss cut stickers best for?
Giveaways, packaging inserts, event handouts, and any time you want an easy peel sticker that protects intricate designs.
